pages.title: Domesticated Animals Get Hungry
pages.text: Once you feed an animal, it becomes domesticated and starts consuming hunger over time.$(br2)Offspring of domesticated animals are domesticated from birth; babies that spawn naturally in the wild stay wild - $(bold)wild babies never burn hunger and never starve$().$(br2)Hunger drains each in-game day based on the configured percentage (default 50% per day). Pregnant animals burn hunger 1.5x faster.

pages.title: Feeding Restores Hunger
pages.text: Right-click a hungry animal with food to restore hunger. Different foods restore different amounts. If hunger reaches zero, the animal enters a starving state and slowly loses health over 3 days — feed it quickly to save it!

pages.title: Why Keep Them Full
pages.text: An injured animal fed past 80% hunger slowly heals; a starving one gives off clear signs, and Jade will show a starving status directly.$(br2)Wild animals and wild babies never burn hunger - only domesticated animals need regular care.
